name: summaries
title: Summary sheets
description: One summary sheet per page, written once, inserted into its page and gathered on a printable all-sheets page.

dir.description: Folder under content/ that holds the sheets.

source.description: Sheet file name for a page of the first (main) kind. Template fields: {id} {kind}.

otherSource.description: Sheet file name for pages of any other kind.

kinds.description: Page kinds that get sheets (list of kind names); null = every kind.

require.description: Warn when a ready page has no sheet.

sectionTitle.description: Heading of the sheet section inserted into each page.

sectionNumber.description: What appears in the heading's number slot and the rail. "auto" = the number after the last numbered section before the sheet (zero-padded like it). A page can override it with front matter "summaryNumber".

sectionId.description: id of the inserted section (anchor target).

sectionSource.description: Optional source line (p.src) under the inserted sheet's heading; empty = none. Fields: the page fields ({noun} {badge} {id} {title} …), {nounLower}, {source} (the sheet's source comment) and {sourceSep} (separator + source, or nothing). HTML allowed.

sourceComment.description: A sheet file may start with <!-- source: … -->; its text becomes {source}. This sets the word before the colon (e.g. "refs"); empty = don't read it.

sourceSeparator.description: Separator used between the parts of source lines.

boxed.description: Draw each sheet in a bordered box. false = the sheet sits in the page like any other section content; on the all-sheets page a rule then separates consecutive sheets.

reviewable.description: Whether the inserted section gets a 'Mark as reviewed' button.

marker.description: Put this comment in a page where the sheet should go; without it the sheet is appended at the end.

file.description: File name of the all-sheets page.

anchor.description: Anchor of a main-kind sheet on the all-sheets page. Fields: {id} {kind}. Change it to match links you already use.

otherAnchor.description: Anchor of other kinds' sheets on the all-sheets page.

intro.default: Every page's summary sheet in one place, for review. Each sheet links back to its full notes.
intro.description: Lede of the all-sheets page (HTML allowed); empty to omit.

backLink.description: Link text under each inserted sheet that jumps to it on the all-sheets page; empty to omit.

backLinkPlacement.description: Where the back link goes: "below" the sheet, or at the end of the "source" line.

notesLink.description: Link text on the all-sheets page back to each page.

entrySource.description: Start of each sheet's line on the all-sheets page, before the links. Same fields as sectionSource.

extraLinks.description: More links per sheet on the all-sheets page, e.g. [{"label": "Self-test", "anchor": "selftest"}].

filters.description: Group filter buttons on the all-sheets page.

filterSets.description: Extra filter buttons that each show several groups: [{"id": "first-half", "label": "First half", "groups": ["part-1", "part-2"]}]. They come before the group buttons.

groupFilterLabel.description: Label of a group's filter button unless the group has its own filterLabel. Fields: {title} {range} (first–last badge of the group's sheets, or the group's range).

groupHeadings.description: Show each group's title (and its sheetNote, or else its note) as a heading above its sheets.

filterAria.description: Accessible name of the filter button group.

printLabel.description: Print button label on the all-sheets page; empty to omit.

homeLink.description: Link on the home page intro line; empty to omit.

topbarLink.description: Link label in every top bar; empty to omit.

railTitle.description: Rail heading on the all-sheets page.
